brief:
Funding cuts to the UN Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees have left Palestinians in Lebanon facing worsening hardship, Al Jazeera English reported. The combined impact of reduced aid and Israel's ongoing military operations has pushed refugee communities deeper into poverty and desperation.

Palestinians in Lebanon already struggled with limited employment opportunities and legal restrictions before the funding crisis. The aid reductions have now stripped away critical services that many depend on for survival, compounding existing vulnerabilities in camps and urban areas across the country.
dek: Funding cuts and Israel's war have left Palestinians in Lebanon in increasingly dire circumstances.
title: UNRWA funding cuts intensify Palestinian refugee crisis in Lebanon
